issues.description: These brief reviews express mixed reactions, including praise, dislike, and negative emoji, without a consistent specific complaint.
Reviews repeatedly say they hate the app but give no specific reason for that reaction.
Reviews express dissatisfaction with the new update, often through brief negative remarks or emojis.
Reviews express general dislike of the application without identifying a specific problem.
Reviews give brief, nonspecific negative assessments of the app or its experience.
